title: MV MOG_BattleHUD: Change Face based on Status affected

posts.author: nProd
posts.body:
Hello guys!
I'm quite new in RPG Maker Developing using the MV version; I've installed the
MOG_BattleHUD
plugin (Classic ver.) to render the image of my characters in the party during a fight.
I have three
Statuses
, ( ID 11, 12, 13 ) and I'd like to
switch
the
image
rendered when one of my
characters is affected
by one of these statuses.
Does anyone know how I can do it? I'm not that good in JS coding, and quite new to RMMV.
Thanks
to everyone for your help!
